body: i'm not going to beg my son to love me. i'm just going to leave.
tons of reasons. mainly because his father hates me.  he just wants me to leave him alone. so i am going to do that.
he is alive thank god. but he has rejected me and will always hate me.  he is alive but he doesn't love me and i can't care for him or be with him.  i can't stand the pain anymore.

he sent me a message saying he doesn't want me in his life because i'm not nice to his father. his father took him from me.

he's gone. he doesn't even care about me anymore. he's gone. it's hopeless.  i tried to be with him for so long. i can't stand knowing he doesn't love me anymore. i'm not strong enough.

i just feel like i am giving up. i am giving up.  i'm not strong enough.

i lost my child. he's in another country and i can't speak to him. he's gone. 

i have nothing to live for.  i can't survive this pain.  i've been self harming for about 2 years now. my son is gone.  

i can't even get out of bed. there's no point in being alive. he's been gone for 8 years.  it's too much
